The new branch in `as_index` applies even under legacy semantics with `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`: a plain tuple-valued Index now denotes full snapshot pairs rather than timestep labels. For example, a network can contain snapshots `(2030, "a")` and `(2030, (2030, "a"))`; requesting a plain Index containing `(2030, "a")` selects the former after the change, rather than the latter under the old timestep-only interpretation. This changes the snapshots passed through `optimize_and_run_non_linear_powerflow` despite that function itself being unchanged.
